# Run book: Query a document and render Markdown

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/query-and-render-text.md) | [Spec](../specs/query-and-render-text.md)

## Contents

- [Purpose](#purpose)
- [Preconditions](#preconditions)
- [Verify](#verify)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

## Purpose

One query language, XPath, reads JSON, YAML, HTML and XML, so extraction code does not change when the format does.

## Preconditions

- The example stack is running.

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Query a document and render Markdown"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/utilities/text`:

1. **Run an XPath query.** The sample JSON document and query are filled in. Run the query to list every match. Expect: The match count and the matching elements are shown.
2. **Render Markdown.** Render the sample Markdown to HTML; scripts and event handlers are stripped before it is shown. Expect: The rendered preview appears.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Could not query the document | The XPath is invalid or the document does not parse in the chosen format | Check the format selector and open Document as XML to see the names XPath can use |
| No matches | JSON and YAML property names become element names | Use // to search at any depth, for example //total |

Related framework features: OoBDev.System (`JsonNavigator`); OoBDev.System.Text.Yaml (`YamlNavigator`); OoBDev.System.Text.Html (`HtmlNavigator`); OoBDev.System.Text.Markdown (Markdig).
